title.zh: Open USD takes on Tether, Circle with a different stablecoin model that's 'building money'
title.en: Open USD takes on Tether, Circle with a different stablecoin model that's 'building money'

current_state.zh: Open USD, the stablecoin backed by founding partners Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa, went live on Ethereum, Solana, Base and Tempo as part of Open Standard's bid to compete with USDT and USDC in payments, banking and institutional settlement, with most company equity to be distributed to partners based on growth contribution.
current_state.en: Open USD, the stablecoin backed by founding partners Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa, went live on Ethereum, Solana, Base and Tempo as part of Open Standard's bid to compete with USDT and USDC in payments, banking and institutional settlement, with most company equity to be distributed to partners based on growth contribution.
